By the game setup, exactly 2 of us started with hunger h = 1 and 3 of us started with h = 0. Anyone with h = 1 who does not eat today will die tonight, whereas players with h = 0 can safely wait until tomorrow without any risk of death (their hunger will just rise to 1).

To be completely transparent: I am one of the two players who started with h = 1, so I must receive 1 unit today to survive. Who is the other player with h = 1? Please speak up honestly.

- 1 food to me (h = 1)
- 1 food to the other player with h = 1
- 1 food to one of the h = 0 players
The two players who receive 0 today will be guaranteed first priority for food on Day 2 when new supply arrives.

Crucially, we should all commit to NO stealing during the Transfers stage—stealing breaks trust and ensures mutually assured destruction. Please share your current hunger level and your thoughts on this rotation plan as we go around the table.
